_comment: Fill in enu_origin and cameras[N].location_enu before running extrinsic_solve.py.

enu_origin.comment: WGS84 lat/lon/alt (decimal degrees, metres) of your ENU coordinate origin. Pick a stable reference point in your field of view.

1.comment: Fill in [east_m, north_m, up_m] offset from enu_origin for camera 1 (cam1.local). Measure with GPS or tape measure.
